Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Kamal Kishor Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Deependra Singh Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard Mr. Kamal Kishor Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. representing the State and Mr. Deependra Singh, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant to quash the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 2826 of 2020 (State Vs. Lokesh and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 70 of 2016, under Sections 498A, 420, 323, 354(b) IPC, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Meerut pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C., Meerut on the basis of compromise.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. representing the State and learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 have no objection to such prayer of learned counsel for the applicants.
In view of the statement made by Mr. Kamal Kishor Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants at the bar, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

Office is directed to return certified copy of the document, if any, after retaining the xerox copy of the same, to learned counsel for the applicants within three days.
